title: 叙述与时态
goal: 用时态区分过去事件、背景和更早的动作，并用顺序词组织经历。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 在叙述中保持时态一致

body.p: 叙述过去的经历，不要求所有动词用同一种时态。I was arranging the chairs when the guests arrived. 中，was arranging 是当时正在进行的背景，arrived 是发生的事件。
过去完成时表示在过去某个时间之前已经完成的动作。I had checked the list before the guests arrived. 说明检查在客人到达前已完成。先后已经由 before、after 标明时，也可以用一般过去时。

cards.title: 过去时态
rows: 一般过去时
讲已经发生的事件，是叙述的主线。
I opened the room and arranged the chairs.
过去进行时
表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作。
I was arranging the chairs when the guests arrived.
过去完成时
表示在过去某个时间之前已完成的动作。
I had checked the list before the guests arrived.
背景与事件
while 引出持续的背景，when 引出发生的事件。
While I was checking names, a guest asked for directions.
明确的先后
before、after 已标明先后时，用一般过去时即可。
After I checked the names, I opened the door.
当前评价
从过去转到现在时，用 today、still 等词标明。
I learned to prepare early. I still use that habit today.

cards.title: 时间顺序
rows: at first
说明最初的状态，常和后来的变化对照。
At first, I could not find the right key.
then / next
引出下一个动作，只表示先后。
I checked the label. Then I tried the smaller key.
before / after
说明两件事的相对时间。
I tested the microphone before the audience entered.
while / meanwhile
表示两件事同时发生。
I arranged the chairs. Meanwhile, a colleague tested the lights.
by the time
给出一个时间点，在此之前完成的动作常用 had done。
By the time the guests arrived, I had unlocked the room.
eventually / finally
引出最后的结果，不用在中间步骤前。
Eventually, we found the correct entrance.
later / afterwards
表示在此之后，只说时间。
We returned the keys afterwards.

cards.title: 过去习惯与时态辨析
rows: used to + 动词原形
表示过去的习惯或状态，常暗示现在已不同。
I used to live above the shop.
would + 动词原形
在过去的背景下表示反复的动作，不用于过去的状态。
When I worked there, I would open the shutters each morning.
单次事件
一次性的事件用一般过去时，不用 would。
Last Friday, I opened the shutters early.
一般过去时错误
Last night I finish it. → Last night I finished it.
Last night, I finished the display.
进行时错误
I was wait when it arrived. → I was waiting when it arrived.
I was waiting when the delivery arrived.
完成时错误
I had wrote it. → I had written it.
I had written the address before I sealed the parcel.
无依据切换到现在
Yesterday I arrived and start work. → arrived and started
Yesterday, I arrived early and started work immediately.

body.box: I was guiding a visitor through the print room when a machine stopped. I had read the safety instructions before the tour. First, I asked the visitor to step back. Then I called the technician. Afterwards, we continued in another room.

Which sequence is consistent with the account?
1. The machine stopped, and the speaker then read the instructions.
2. The speaker read the instructions before the machine stopped during the tour.
3. The speaker called the technician before asking the visitor to step back.
4. The visitor continued the tour before the machine stopped.

body.p: 第二项正确。had read 把阅读放在参观之前，停机发生在参观途中。was guiding 是停机时的背景。First、Then、Afterwards 依次标出退后、呼叫技术员和继续参观。

groups.text: The speaker was serving refreshments when the concert ended. Serving had begun earlier and was still in progress.

options: I served refreshments only after the concert ended.
I was serving refreshments when the concert ended.
I had finished serving before the concert ended.
I will serve refreshments when the concert ends.
items.why: 材料说 was still in progress，所以用过去进行时，即第二项。第三项的 had finished 表示已经结束。

groups.text: The speaker submitted the application on Monday. The interview took place on Thursday. The answer describes the earlier action from the interview's viewpoint.

items.stem: Which sentence makes that earlier completion explicit?
options: I was submitting the application throughout the interview.
I submitted the application after the interview.
I had submitted the application before the interview.
I have not submitted the application for the interview.
items.why: Monday 早于 Thursday。第三项用 had submitted 表示申请在面试前已经提交。

groups.text: The speaker no longer owns a scooter but owned one throughout the first year of college.

items.stem: Which sentence expresses this past state?
options: I used to own a scooter during my first year.
I would buy a scooter every day during my first year.
I was borrowing a scooter when my first year began.
I still own the scooter I bought in my first year.
items.why: owned one throughout 和 no longer owns 说明这是过去的状态，用 used to own，即第一项。

groups.text: The speaker describes a completed trip: Yesterday I reached the campsite and unpack my bag.

items.stem: Which revision keeps the events in the stated past?
options: Yesterday I reach the campsite and unpack my bag.
Yesterday I will reach the campsite and unpack my bag.
Yesterday I have reached the campsite and unpacked my bag.
Yesterday I reached the campsite and unpacked my bag.
items.why: Yesterday 是已经结束的过去，两个动词都用一般过去时 reached 和 unpacked，即第四项。

groups.text: The volunteer checked the lights. After that, the audience entered. The performance began last.

options: The audience entered after the performance began.
The lights were checked before the audience entered.
The performance began before the lights were checked.
The lights were checked after the audience entered.
items.why: 先 checked the lights，After that 观众入场。第二项用 before 保留了这个顺序。

groups.text: At first, the hiking group followed the wrong path. Later, it found the signpost. Finally, it reached the hut.

items.stem: What belongs after 'Finally' in this account?
options: The group started following the wrong path.
The group began looking for the signpost.
The group arrived at the hut.
The group had not yet left the starting point.
items.why: Finally 后面是 it reached the hut，第三项的 arrived at 是 reached 的同义改写。

groups.text: While I copied the measurements, my partner drew the outline.

options: The copying and drawing overlapped in time.
The drawing ended before copying began.
The copying caused the drawing to stop.
The drawing began only after copying ended.
items.why: While I copied … my partner drew 表示两件事同时进行，即第一项。

groups.text: The organizer saved the registration list before restarting the computer. Afterwards, the list was reopened.

options: Restart, save, reopen
Reopen, restart, save
Save, reopen, restart
Save, restart, reopen
items.why: before restarting 说明先保存再重启，Afterwards 说明重启之后再打开，即第四项。

lines.text: I was sorting donated coats when the storage door opened.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: was sorting 表示开门时动作还在进行；had sorted 表示已经完成。

lines.text: We had tested the projector before the guests entered.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: had tested 表示客人进入前测试已完成；were testing 表示还在进行。

lines.text: I used to keep a handwritten account of every expense.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: used to keep 表示过去的习惯；am keeping 是现在正在进行。

lines.text: When I worked at the bakery, I would check the orders each morning.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.lead: When I worked at the bakery,
items.why: When I worked at the bakery 是过去的背景，each morning 表示反复，所以用 would check。

groups.text: A student scanned the sculpture first. The digital model was edited next. A small replica was printed only after editing was complete.

items.stem: Which sentence gives the final stage?
options: Finally, the student printed a small replica.
Finally, the student began scanning the sculpture.
Finally, the student edited the model before scanning.
Finally, the student printed before editing the model.
items.why: printed only after editing was complete 说明打印是最后一步，即第一项。

groups.text: A student prepared the dye while a partner washed the fabric. Both tasks finished before the fabric was placed in the dye.

items.stem: Which sentence preserves the simultaneous preparation?
options: The fabric was dyed before either preparation task.
Meanwhile, the partner was washing the fabric.
After dyeing, the partner began washing the fabric.
The partner washed the fabric only after the dye was used.
items.why: while a partner washed 表示两项准备同时进行，第二项用 Meanwhile 保留了这一关系。

groups.text: A researcher initially recorded observations on loose cards. Later she numbered the cards. Only then did she enter the records into a spreadsheet.

items.stem: What follows 'Only then' in the account?
options: She began making the first loose cards.
She numbered cards after entering their records.
She transferred the records into a spreadsheet.
She stopped recording observations before numbering.
items.why: Only then 后面是 did she enter the records into a spreadsheet，第三项的 transferred 是 enter 的同义改写。

groups.text: The debate pair rehearsed the opening before checking the references. After checking, they shortened the closing. At first, however, they had disagreed about the opening.

items.stem: Which event belongs at the beginning of the narrative?
options: They shortened the closing after checking references.
They checked references after rehearsing the opening.
They finished rehearsing an agreed opening.
They disagreed about how the opening should begin.
items.why: At first … had disagreed 说明最开始两人意见不一，即第四项。
